children: Canada food retailer's fiscal Q1 sales grew 2.6% yr/yr, slightly missing analyst expectations
EPS for fiscal Q1 rose 14.3% yr/yr
Company completed Mayrand Food Group Inc. acquisition and expanded FreshCo discount banner
Empire expects fiscal 2027 capital spend of about C$850 mln, with half for store expansion
Company expects annualized e-commerce operating income improvement of about C$95 mln in fiscal 2027
Empire expects fiscal 2027 other income plus share of earnings from investments at C$90 mln-C$110 mln
FULL-SERVICE AND DISCOUNT BANNERS - Co said sales growth was primarily driven by positive performance in Full-Service and Discount banners
FUEL SALES - Higher fuel prices led to an 18.4% increase in fuel sales
COST DISCIPLINE - Lower selling and administrative expenses contributed to higher operating income
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 5 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the food retail & distribution peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for EMPIRE COMPANY LIMITED is C$56.00, about 17% above its September 9 closing price of C$47.87
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
